about: Get an official record of your general vaccinations, other than COVID-19.
note: Requirements read from the official DHA service page on the checked date. DHA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Your vaccination records must exist in your HASANA file
documents: No documents needed beyond the MRN, Emirates ID or passport number used to find your record
